notes.title: Small Update, but not TOO small to care about!
notes.content:
[h1]Draw one at a time mode is in.[/h1]
Tired of seeing the card you want glide past? Bug fan of clicking? Click away. You can now switch between draw three and draw one modes at anytime.

[h1]Sticky click option is in.[/h1] 
For some of you dragging is a bit of a drag. Now you can activate stick click and save your energy for more important things. Hope it helps.

[h1]Idling to waste time is out![/h1]
It was recently brought up that the time wasted was stat was rising whether or not you where playing or just letting the game run. That was a bug and it has been fixed. If you where counting on idling your way to the "secret" waste 1000 hours achievement, sorry. That's not going to work. But take heart... That was always supposed to be a joke, not a thing anyone could do. Since some of you really like to get all of the achievements, the numbers to unlock them have been reduced to... ahem... [i]reasonable[/i] levels. So go out and achieve! 

Thanks for playing. Keep wasting time and remember... Slacking off is its own reward.
